scenes.text: THIS MORNING I'M ON THE SHELF
scenes.narration: This morning I am on the shelf in the lost property cage. The new one. There is a tag around my wrist.
scenes.imagePrompt: Inside a wire mesh cage, a figure lying on a long steel shelf in a grey cardigan, a brown luggage tag tied around one wrist, face turned to the wall, no face visible, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: Somebody has opened the office. He is wearing my cardigan and my glasses, and he hangs his keys on my belt clip.
scenes.imagePrompt: A person in a grey cardigan standing behind a wooden counter seen from inside a wire mesh cage, back to the camera, lit by a single bulb, no face visible, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.text: HE NEVER LOOKS AT THE SHELVES
scenes.narration: He does not look at the shelves. He opens the log and writes, in my handwriting, neater than mine.
scenes.imagePrompt: A hand writing in a thick ledger with a fountain pen, a grey cardigan sleeve at the wrist, the rest of the person out of frame, no face visible, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: There is something on the counter for him already. He is patting his pocket. Somebody handed in my wallet today.
scenes.imagePrompt: A worn brown leather wallet lying on a scratched wooden counter with a brown luggage tag tied to it on string, a brass counter bell beside it, no people, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain
